Class Pokemon

java.lang.Object
Pokemon
public class Pokemon extends Object
Stores a Pokémon's National Pokédex identity, types, debut generation, and six base stats.

  • Constructor Details

    • Pokemon

      public Pokemon(int id, String name, int generation, String primaryType, String secondaryType, int hp, int atk, int def, int spatk, int spdef, int speed)
      Creates a Pokémon and calculates its base stat total.
      Parameters:
      id - the National Pokédex number
      name - the species name
      generation - the debut generation
      primaryType - the primary type
      secondaryType - the secondary type, or null for a single-type Pokémon
      hp - the base hit points
      atk - the base attack
      def - the base defense
      spatk - the base special attack
      spdef - the base special defense
      speed - the base speed
